text:
Benld had 1 licensed child care provider in 2025
K. E. Rogers
In 2025, there was 1 licensed child care facility in Benld, the Illinois Department of Children and Family Services reports.
The single child care provider was licensed as a day care center.
Benld's provider mainly serves children ages 3 to 6 years.
Services are provided in English.
Across Illinois, there were 8,602 licensed child care facilities in 2025.
The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services froze specific federal child care and family assistance funds for California, Colorado, Minnesota, New York and Illinois because of concerns about fraud and misuse, the agency announced Jan. 6. The freeze affects nearly $2.4 billion from Child Care and Development Fund grants, $7.35 billion in Temporary Assistance for Needy Families funds, and $869 million in Social Services Block Grants, requiring states to provide documentation before funds are released.
Illinois Gov. J.B. Pritzker described the freeze as “wrong and cruel” and indicated the state could challenge the action, saying Illinois already has anti-fraud measures.
According to state officials, approximately 100,000 families and over 152,000 children who participate in the Child Care Assistance Program may be affected, along with thousands of child care providers and 275 human service organizations.
